title: Kissed Flaky Thai Tofu Nam Prik
description: A fatty and flaky Thai dish featuring currants and tempering chocolate, perfect for a lazy Sunday, this shojin-friendly nam prik is served on a slate tile.

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the tofu from the skillet and set aside on a plate.
Add the Thai red curry paste to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the fish-free nam prik pao, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the currants and chopped tempering chocolate to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the tofu to the skillet and stir to combine with the nam prik mixture.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the kissed flaky Thai tofu nam prik on a slate tile, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro.
